subject: Intern cohort banding, HC allocation and return-offer approvals
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intern cohort banding, HC allocation and return-offer approvals

Hi team —

We need approval to finalize the return-offer list and a small set of band adjustments for the 2027 summer interns in Eng Infra and Observability. Hiring/recruiting need headcount & band confirmations by next Monday so we can issue formal offers ahead of orientation. Summary below; full workbook attached (intern_band_adjustments_2027Q3.xlsx).

High-level ask:
- Approve 6 return offers across Eng Infra + Observability (list + recommended bands below).
- Approve two band upgrades (from Band 2 -> Band 3) for exceptional performers (detailed justification in sheet).
- Confirm these offers will be charged to FY27 internships budget (code: HR-INTR-27) and do not require additional headcount beyond the 5.6 FTE intern allocation already approved — request reallocation of 0.4 FTE from contractor pool.

Candidates & recommendation (short):
- A. Khatri (Infra) — recommend Band 3, return as New Grad SWE (strong infra systems internship, led KV cache perf work).
- L. Ortiz (Observability) — recommend Band 2, return as SWE I.
- J. Patel (Infra) — recommend Band 2, return as SWE I.
- S. Ramos (external candidate we coordinated earlier) — recommend Band 3 (offer contingent on final background).
- R. Gomez (Observability) — recommend Band 2.
- C. Nguyen (Infra) — recommend Band 2 (part-time conversion to full).

Attachments: intern_band_adjustments_2027Q3.xlsx (spreadsheet), return_offer_summary_2027Q3.pdf (summary).

Goal: approvals from HR + Eng managers for banding and the small FTE reallocation by 2027-08-01 COB. If approved, Recruiting will send offers on 2027-08-02.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. TPM, University Programs & Early Talent
Redwood Inference

---
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intern cohort banding, HC allocation and return-offer approvals

Marissa —

Thanks for the summary and the workbook. Quick clarifying questions before I sign off:
1) For the two proposed band upgrades (A. Khatri and S. Ramos), can you add the short justification blurb in the email body (I wasn't able to open the spreadsheet on my phone). Specifically: impact, ownership, and peer feedback.
2) Confirm total comp impact (annualized run rate) for the two upgrades — HR needs to note the delta for payroll planning.
3) Are any of these interns moving to a hiring manager outside of Eng Infra/Observability? I need manager-of-record for headcount mapping.

If you can reply with the above, I can provide formal HR approval and update Workday.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Early Talent & University Programs
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intern cohort banding, HC allocation and return-offer approvals

Laura — thanks, answers inline below. I also attached the two docs again in case the original didn't load.

1) Justification blurbs (short):
- Arjun Khatri — ownership: implemented KV-prefetch optimization in the inference runtime, reduced cold-start latency by ~18% on internal perf tests. Took lead on design & paired with infra team; received two peer nominations for impact. Recommendation: Band 3 to reflect code ownership and on-call readiness for New Grad SWE.
- Sophie Ramos — ownership: built an observability export that improved signal fidelity for tokenization traces; ran a proto-to-prod handoff with SRE. Strong mentorship score and excellent cross-team communication. Recommendation: Band 3 due to cross-functional delivery and high product impact.

2) Comp delta (annualized run rate):
- Arjun Khatri: Estimated increase ~$9,200/yr (Band2->Band3 delta)
- Sophie Ramos: Estimated increase ~$8,600/yr
Total delta: ~$17,800/yr (to be charged pro-rata to FY27 internships budget for 0.4 FTE reallocation).

3) Managers-of-record: all remain within Eng Infra or Observability:
- A. Khatri -> Markus Klein (Eng Infra)
- L. Ortiz -> Tessa Morgan (Observability)
- J. Patel -> Markus Klein
- S. Ramos -> Tessa Morgan
- R. Gomez -> Tessa Morgan
- C. Nguyen -> Markus Klein

Let me know if this is enough for HR to approve.

Marissa

Attachment: intern_band_adjustments_2027Q3.xlsx (again)
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intern cohort banding, HC allocation and return-offer approvals

Quick note from Eng Infra — I approve the Band 3 recommendation for Arjun Khatri. His perf work materially affected our GC/latency regressions and the team supports promoting him.

One ask: for Sophie Ramos, can we add an explicit on-call readiness check as a condition of the Band 3 offer? She's transitioned from a research-focused project and I want a 3-month ramp with mentor pairing documented. If HR agrees, I'm fine with Band 3 conditional on meeting the ramp milestone.

Also confirm the 0.4 FTE reallocation from contractor pool is good with finance — I don't want any surprises.

-Markus
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 01 Aug 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intern cohort banding, HC allocation and return-offer approvals

All —

Thanks for the details. HR approves the six return offers with the following conditions:
- Arjun Khatri: approve Band 3 and comp delta as outlined. HR will update Workday and ensure payroll codes are set to HR-INTR-27 pro-rata.
- Sophie Ramos: approve Band 3 but include a conditional on-call ramp milestone (3 months) in the offer letter. Recruiting will add the ramp plan as an attachment.
- Remaining interns: approve Band 2 as listed.
- 0.4 FTE reallocation from contractor pool approved pending Finance confirmation; Stephanie, please loop Finance and confirm by EOD Monday.

Marissa — please confirm you want Recruiting to send the offers on 2027-08-02. Once Stephanie confirms finance it's a wrap from HR.

Laura
